description.de: Zwei Wege zur Ampel eines Laufs: checked_command leitet sie aus dem Exit-Code ab (0 = GREEN), ein Skript kann sie mit gate_status selbst melden. Der strengste Wert gewinnt – hier YELLOW. Ersetze beide Prüfungen.
description.en: Two ways to a run's traffic light: checked_command derives it from the exit code (0 = GREEN), a script can report it itself with gate_status. The strictest value wins – YELLOW here. Replace both checks.

config.command:
# placeholder - replace with your own check; exit 0 = GREEN
test -d .

# placeholder - a script can report its own traffic light
printf 'gate_status: YELLOW
gate_category: blueprint-warning
gate_description: example warning from a blueprint
'
